# 假设 _input 是 n8n 的输入列表，每个 item 是 dict，文本字段在 item["json"]["text"]
output = []

for item in _input.all():
    text = item.get("json", {}).get("output", "")

    # 提取 <think> 标签内容
    import re
    # think_match = re.search(r"<think>([\s\S]*?)</think>", text)
    # think_content = think_match.group(1).strip() if think_match else ""

    # 提取问题总结
    summary_match = re.search(r"问题总结：([\s\S]*?)\s{2,}", text)
    problem_summary = summary_match.group(1).strip() if summary_match else ""

    # 提取问题现象
    phenomenon_match = re.search(r"问题现象：([\s\S]*?)\s{2,}", text)
    problem_phenomenon = phenomenon_match.group(1).strip() if phenomenon_match else ""

    # 提取具体复现步骤
    steps_match = re.search(r"具体复现步骤：([\s\S]*)", text)
    reproduce_steps = steps_match.group(1).strip() if steps_match else ""

    # 生成输出 item
    output.append({
        "json": {
            "problemSummary": problem_summary,
            "problemPhenomenon": problem_phenomenon,
            "reproduceSteps": reproduce_steps
        }
    })

# 返回 n8n 需要的格式
return output

comments = items[0].get("json", {}).get("comments_list", [])
max_len = 512

chunks = []
current_chunk = ""

for comment in comments:
    if not comment:
        continue

    # 如果单条 comment 本身超过 512，则直接当成独立 chunk
    if len(comment) > max_len:
        if current_chunk:
            chunks.append(current_chunk)
            current_chunk = ""
        chunks.append(comment)
        continue

    # 当前 chunk + 本条 comment 会不会超过 512
    if len(current_chunk) + len(comment) > max_len:
        # 结算当前 chunk
        if current_chunk:
            chunks.append(current_chunk)
        current_chunk = comment  # 新开一段
    else:
        # 同一段继续添加
        current_chunk += comment

# 最后一段
if current_chunk:
    chunks.append(current_chunk)

# 返回给 n8n
return [{"json": {"chunk": c}} for c in chunks]

import re

def sanitize_and_shorten(text):
    # 1. 特殊字符替换成 "_"
    text = re.sub(r'[^0-9A-Za-z\u4e00-\u9fa5]', '_', text)

    # 2. 若不超过30个字符，直接返回
    if len(text) <= 30:
        return text

    # 3. 超过30字符 → 前20 + "***" + 后10
    return text[:20] + "***" + text[-10:]


# n8n 代码：处理每个 item
for item in _input.all():
    filename = item.json.get("filename", "")
    item.json["filename"] = sanitize_and_shorten(filename)

return _input.all()

import json
import re

# 输入内容
raw_text = _input.all()[0]["json"].get("a", "")

# 初始化结构化 JSON
structured_json = {
    "jira_id": "",
    "issue_description": "",
    "reproduction_steps": [],
    "software_version": "",
    "hardware_version": "",
    "chip": "",
    "components": "",
    "key_error_logs": "",
    "comments": [],
    "root_cause": "",
    "how_to_fix": "",
    "patch_list": [],
    "doc_link": [],
    "source": "",
}

# ------------------------------
# jira_id
# ------------------------------
m = re.search(r"jira_id[:：]\s*(\S+)", raw_text)
if m:
    structured_json["jira_id"] = m.group(1).strip()

# ------------------------------
# 现象 issue_description
# ------------------------------
m = re.search(r"现象[:：]\s*([\s\S]*?)\n\n", raw_text)
if m:
    structured_json["issue_description"] = m.group(1).strip()

# ------------------------------
# 复现步骤 (Step1 Step2 ...)
# ------------------------------
m = re.search(r"复现步骤[:：]\s*([\s\S]*?)\n\n", raw_text)
if m:
    steps_text = m.group(1)
    steps = re.findall(r"(Step\d+：.*?)(?=Step\d+：|$)", steps_text, re.S)
    structured_json["reproduction_steps"] = [s.strip() for s in steps]

# ------------------------------
# 软件版本
# ------------------------------
m = re.search(r"软件版本[:：]([\s\S]*?)(?:硬件版本[:：]|评论[:：]|$)", raw_text)
if m:
    structured_json["software_version"] = m.group(1).strip()

# ------------------------------
# 硬件版本
# ------------------------------
m = re.search(r"硬件版本[:：]([\s\S]*?)(?:chip[:：]|components[:：]|评论[:：]|$)", raw_text)
if m:
    structured_json["hardware_version"] = m.group(1).strip()

# ------------------------------
# chip
# ------------------------------
m = re.search(r"chip[:：]([\s\S]*?)(?:components[:：]|key_error_logs[:：]|评论[:：]|$)", raw_text)
if m:
    structured_json["chip"] = m.group(1).strip()

# ------------------------------
# components
# ------------------------------
m = re.search(r"components[:：]([\s\S]*?)(?:key_error_logs[:：]|root_cause[:：]|评论[:：]|$)", raw_text)
if m:
    structured_json["components"] = m.group(1).strip()

# ------------------------------
# key_error_logs
# ------------------------------
m = re.search(r"key_error_logs[:：]([\s\S]*?)(?:root_cause[:：]|how_to_fix[:：]|评论[:：]|$)", raw_text)
if m:
    structured_json["key_error_logs"] = m.group(1).strip()

# ------------------------------
# root_cause
# ------------------------------
m = re.search(r"root_cause[:：]([\s\S]*?)(?:how_to_fix[:：]|patch_list[:：]|评论[:：]|$)", raw_text)
if m:
    structured_json["root_cause"] = m.group(1).strip()

# ------------------------------
# how_to_fix
# ------------------------------
m = re.search(r"how_to_fix[:：]([\s\S]*?)(?:patch_list[:：]|doc_link[:：]|评论[:：]|$)", raw_text)
if m:
    structured_json["how_to_fix"] = m.group(1).strip()

# ------------------------------
# patch_list
# ------------------------------
m = re.search(r"patch_list[:：]([\s\S]*?)(?:doc_link[:：]|source[:：]|评论[:：]|$)", raw_text)
if m:
    t = m.group(1).strip()
    if t:
        structured_json["patch_list"] = [t]

# ------------------------------
# doc_link
# ------------------------------
m = re.search(r"doc_link[:：]([\s\S]*?)(?:source[:：]|评论[:：]|$)", raw_text)
if m:
    t = m.group(1).strip()
    if t:
        structured_json["doc_link"] = [t]

# ------------------------------
# source
# ------------------------------
m = re.search(r"source[:：]([\s\S]*?)(?:评论[:：]|$)", raw_text)
if m:
    structured_json["source"] = m.group(1).strip()

# ------------------------------
# 评论（三级结构）
# ------------------------------
fx = re.search(r"1、复现方式与现象[:：]\s*([\s\S]*?)\s*2、定位结果[:：]", raw_text)
dw = re.search(r"2、定位结果[:：]\s*([\s\S]*?)\s*3、解决方案[:：]", raw_text)
jj = re.search(r"3、解决方案[:：]\s*([\s\S]*)", raw_text)

structured_json["comments"] = [
    {"level": "复现方式与现象", "description": fx.group(1).strip()} if fx else {"level": "复现方式与现象", "description": ""},
    {"level": "定位结果", "description": dw.group(1).strip()} if dw else {"level": "定位结果", "description": ""},
    {"level": "解决方案", "description": jj.group(1).strip()} if jj else {"level": "解决方案", "description": ""}
]

# ------------------------------
# 输出
# ------------------------------
return [{
    "json": {
        "qa_structured_json": json.dumps(structured_json, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    }
}]
